answer: Commit-reveal admission bound to a future beacon. Each identity locks a 0.30-unit escrow and files a hash of its work portfolio at epoch N, e.g. a timber harvest log, a lagoon water survey, or an opal grading sheet. At epoch N+3 the beacon publishes a random value selecting 25% of submissions for audit; the identity then reveals its portfolio. Forged portfolios burn the escrow and exclude the identity for 20 epochs. Cost: 100 sybils post 30 units; about 25 are audited, forged ones burn, so attackers forfeit 30 units plus 20 epochs of income per identity.
